lead: A `rule:` target after an option on `peek.py`'s command line is refused as an unrecognized argument.
body: The option ends the positional run argparse is collecting targets into, so `peek.py a.rs:1-20 --context 5 rule:types/conversion` fails outright while the same call with the `rule:` token written before `--context` reads both. Put every target first and every option last, which is the order the tool's own usage line prints them in.
